ast.name: ngOnInit
ast.$comment_leaf: isLeaf true because it calls no other member of this class. It does call two injected services, which is a dependency edge rather than an in-file call-graph edge.

subscriptions.$comment: Anonymous under D12a. Derived leakRisk: 'possible' -- an explicit subscribe with no teardown -- computed from the two fields below rather than stored.

doc.explanation: Begins watching the address bar's query values and, for each set received, asks the activation service to redeem the key they carry. Records the outcome in two independent flags: success on a reply, error on a failure.
sideEffects: issues one read request to the activation endpoint per set of query values received
holds a subscription that is never explicitly cancelled
edgeCases: neither flag is reset, so a success followed by a failure leaves both set
reporting a failure ends the underlying stream, so no later change to the address is acted on
an absent key is passed through as undefined rather than handled distinctly
doc.$comment_stream: The stream explanation that lived on stream:queryParamsActivation now belongs here: each set of query values from the router becomes a redemption request. mergeMap does not cancel an in-flight request when new values arrive, so overlapping attempts are possible.

cases.title: calls activate.get with the key from params
should set set success to true upon successful activation
should set set error to true upon activation failure

tests.$comment_template: The suite replaces the component's markup with an empty string (spec line 22), so no test exercises the template. Every rendering behavior in template.json#/uiRequirements is uncorroborated by tests.
